locked_twist.statement: The Locked Twist: the field wakes at matter-radiation equality and beats the standard model on the fair score
locked_twist.mechanism: early energy shrinks the sound ruler; switch-on fixed by the measured amounts of light and matter
locked_twist.data: Planck 2018 + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+; blind: P-ACT (Planck cut + ACT DR6 + ACTxPR4 lensing) + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+
locked_twist.result: Rule (??? < ?4, ?AIC < 0) met twice: fair Planck (polished ?CDM) ??? ?4.70 (??_eff ?4.97), ?AIC ?0.70, 1.7?; BLIND P-ACT ??? ?7.23 (??_eff ?7.14), ?AIC ?3.23, 2.2? (p = 0.027). Holds with DES Y5 ?4.55, Dovekie ?5.08, Union3 ?4.91.
locked_twist.source: cmb-fit/results: cmp_edelockP vs cmp_lcdmP; cmp_pact_edelock vs cmp_pact_lcdm; COMPARE.md (2026-10-29)
locked_twist.note: Caveats: P-ACT shares Planck low-?, cut Planck high-?, DESI and Pantheon+ with the original fit (only ACT DR6 is new). The lock was chosen after the first free fit (disclosed in the prereg). Overall verdict under PREREGISTRATION_VERDICT.md is TIE because of S8; see twist_verdict.

pure_torsion_width.statement: The field's width equals the pure-torsion value F = 1.2247 M_Pl
pure_torsion_width.mechanism: period set by the Immirzi field normalisation √(3/2)

whole_number_width.statement: The width is the torsion value divided by a whole number (instanton charge)
whole_number_width.result: best N ≈ 8.9; 7.7 to 10.1 fit within Δχ² = 1 (rule needed ±0.5); controls 8.5 and 9.5 only 0.15 and 0.5 worse than N = 9 (rule needed 1)
whole_number_width.note: 1.2247 ÷ F = 8.97 was seen before the rule was written.

dodecahedral_space.statement: Space is a Poincaré dodecahedral space (needs curvature Ω_k ≈ −0.013)
dodecahedral_space.mechanism: closed curved space with opposite faces joined
dodecahedral_space.result: Δχ² = +163 against flat space (rule: excluded above 9)

curved_space.mechanism: spatial curvature Ω_k in the expansion history
curved_space.result: Ω_k = 0.0002 with curvature free; Δχ² = −0.9 for one extra setting (rule needed 9): flat

exoplanet_locks.statement: Planet pairs sit just wide of simple rhythms (2:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:4) more often than chance
exoplanet_locks.mechanism: convergent migration while planets were still in their birth disc
exoplanet_locks.data: NASA Exoplanet Archive: 1,153 adjacent pairs in 1,067 systems
exoplanet_locks.note: A known effect (Lithwick & Wu 2012; Fabrycky et al. 2014): this confirms the method and standard disc-migration physics. It is consistent with the Sigil Model but not unique support for it.

tidal_locks.statement: Locks are stronger where tides are strongest (inner period under 10 days)
tidal_locks.result: compact E = 1.90 vs wide E = 2.42 (the wrong way)

impact_rhythm.statement: Large impact craters repeat on a ~30-million-year rhythm
impact_rhythm.mechanism: the Sun's passages through the galactic disc stirring comets
impact_rhythm.result: best 27.7 Myr, p = 0.33 (chance does as well 1 time in 3)

twist_free.statement: The Twist with all three settings free
twist_free.result: Fair Planck ??? ?4.89 (?AIC +1.11, 1.3?); blind P-ACT ?7.47 (?AIC ?1.47, 1.9?). The 3-setting version pays more AIC than the locked one.
twist_free.source: cmb-fit/results: cmp_edeP vs cmp_lcdmP; cmp_pact_ede vs cmp_pact_lcdm

pr4_improvement.statement: The Twist improves the fit to Planck PR4
pr4_improvement.result: the claimed −3.4 came from foreground priors; the data's own Δχ² is +0.1

fingerprint.statement: The potential repeats in 1/γ (the lopsided Fingerprint)
fingerprint.note: Rule written; fit not yet run.

cosmic_bell.statement: The Twist keeps the seven acoustic peaks in place and shrinks the sound ruler 2.9%
cosmic_bell.note: A computed consequence, not a test against the standard model.

stacked_spot.statement: Stacking hot spots can tell the Twist from the standard model
stacked_spot.result: patterns differ by 0.6%; ring switches at 0.30°, 0.84°, 2.17° in both

metatron_ratios.statement: Our fitted numbers match Metatron's Cube ratios more than chance
metatron_ratios.note: Rule written in the script header before running.

solar_cycle_planets.statement: Venus, Earth and Jupiter's tides pace the 11-year sunspot cycle
solar_cycle_planets.result: mean minima 11.070 yr = V-E-J 11.07 yr, but 281 planet periods fall in 9–13 yr

mixmaster_trigger.statement: Early-universe axis flips (the Mixmaster) set when the field wakes

spin_trigger.statement: The field couples to the spin of matter and stirs when matter takes over
spin_trigger.note: Open problem 2; would explain the lock.

hold_release.statement: A hold term fed by radiation and drained by matter keeps the Twist field on its unstable hilltop, then releases it near matter-radiation equality; the fitted start (0.886 pi) is the release snapshot at 94% of threshold, and the switch-on balance beta/alpha is ~1.005.
hold_release.result: First check (cmb-fit/PREREG_THETA.md): HILLTOP REQUIRED. ?_i fixed at 2.00 ? ??? +5.68 and 1.50 ? +4.22 vs the free fit (?_i 2.784); 2.40 +4.19, 2.60 +2.01, 2.95 +0.39. Known EDE behaviour, so it supports but does not single out the hold mechanism. Final point ?_i 3.10 (almost exactly on the peak) ? +3.41: the best start is just below the peak (?2.8?2.95), not on it, consistent with a release snapshot rather than a field sitting exactly at the top.
hold_release.note: Copilot's math for Danny, 2026-10-29. Needs: a torsion origin for the hold term; integration showing the release snapshot; the Twist-1H rule pre-registered before any fit. First check: PREREG_THETA.md (queued).

twist_verdict.statement: Overall verdict on the Locked Twist under the rule locked before the last results were read.
twist_verdict.result: TIE. Blind test passed, fair Planck passed and all three supernova sets passed, but the S8 penalty is +2.41 against DES Y3+KiDS-1000 (limit 2; +0.39 against KiDS-Legacy). With that S8 included in the fit the gain falls to ??? ?2.92 (?AIC +1.08). Beside the verdict: with SH0ES ??? ?30.2, H0 72.24 (not independent).
twist_verdict.note: It favours early energy switching on at matter-radiation equality; it does not show torsion is the cause (the torsion-only width F failed). Decided by the lensing surveys: if KiDS-Legacy is right the rule gives PREFERRED.

module_n9.statement: The field width is one ninth of the torsion value, F = sqrt(3/2) M_Pl / 9 = 0.1361 M_Pl, giving a one-setting Locked Twist.
module_n9.mechanism: torsion-born field with width set by a whole-number module N (instanton-like cos(N theta)); N not yet derived
module_n9.data: Blind: P-ACT (Planck cut + ACT DR6 + ACTxPR4 lensing) + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+; also Planck 2018 + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+
module_n9.result: T1 (free width on ACT, predicted N = 9 +/- 0.5): FAIL, N = 7.998. T2 (width fixed at 1/9, one free setting, blind ACT): PASS, dchi2 -6.14 vs LCDM, dAIC -4.14, p = 0.013 (2.5 sigma); Planck: dchi2 -4.46, dAIC -2.46 (not blind; 9 came from Planck).
module_n9.source: cmb-fit/results: cmp_pact_edelock_F9 vs cmp_pact_lcdm; cmp_edelockP_F9 vs cmp_lcdmP; F read from CAMB at each minimum
module_n9.note: Split: the free width drifts (Planck 8.5-9.0, ACT 8.0), yet fixing it at 1/9 costs little and wins on AIC. The S8 tension (twist_verdict: tie) is not addressed by this. N = 9 is not derived from physics.
